[[Metagoniolithoideae]] }} The '''Corallinaceae''' are one of the two extant [[Coralline algae|Coralline]] families of [[red algae]]; they are differentiated from the [[Morphology (biology)|morphologically]] similar [[Sporolithaceae]] by their formation of grouped [[Sporangium|sporangial]] chambers, clustered into [[sorus|sori]].{{cite book | url = https://books.google.com/books?id=_29tNNeQKeMC&dq=Litostroma&pg=PA149 | title = Paleobotany: the biology and evolution of fossil plants | isbn = 978-0-12-373972-8 | author1 = Taylor, Thomas N | author2 = Taylor, Edith L | author3 = Krings, Michael | year = 2009}} The Corallinoideae is [[Monophyly|monophyletic]]; the other subfamilies form another monophyletic group.{{Cite journal| last1 = Aguirre | first1 = J.| last2 = Perfectti | first2 = F.| last3 = Braga | first3 = J.
